title: Arrow of Roaring Thunder
summary: Deals weapon damage. Creatures in the 7 ft-radius blast can be pushed about 16 ft. A DC 12 Strength save negates the push.

fields.Activation: Action. Fire from a ranged weapon and consume one arrow. Range 60 ft.
fields.Effect: Deals weapon damage. Creatures in the 7 ft-radius blast can be pushed about 16 ft. A DC 12 Strength save negates the push.
fields.Restrictions: Special arrows cannot be used with off-hand ranged attacks.
fields.Crafting: Special arrows are obtained from loot or vendors.
fields.Creative use: Push enemies away from a contested position.
fields.Base value: 20 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
